Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great conversation and helpful context on where Hightower AI is headed. Quick recap and next steps below.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: inference at scale for multi-tenant customer embeddings + low-latency generation for search enrichment.
- Success metrics: P99 latency < 200ms, target cost per 1M tokens <$12, and easy model version rollouts.
- Stakeholders to include: infra/ops (Raj), security (Priya already on thread), and product (you).

Proposed 30-minute intro/demo (pick one):
1) Tue Sep 21 — 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET
2) Wed Sep 22 — 11:30 AM PT / 2:30 PM ET
3) Thu Sep 23 — 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET

If none of these work, tell us two windows that do and we'll accommodate. Also let us know whether we should include a short tech pre-read for your infra lead (we can send a one-page service architecture & security notes).

Attachments: discovery_notes_hightower.pdf, MVP_requirements.xlsx (stubs attached)

Next steps: once you pick a slot, we'll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda and the technical deep-dive owner (Ben) on the call.

Thanks,
